evals.prompt: build a settings screen for this app
evals.expected_output: Looks for DESIGN.md, design-system/MASTER.md, CLAUDE.md design notes and token files first and follows them; uses tokens, not raw hex; builds loading, empty and error states; checks light and dark at a small phone width; names any gaps it filled.

evals.prompt: this landing page looks generic, make it better
evals.expected_output: Names the specific template smells it found, proposes three distinct directions (style family, brand colour, type pairing, signature detail) instead of tweaking shadows, checks contrast with scripts/contrast.py, and offers to record the chosen direction in DESIGN.md.

evals.prompt: we're starting a new habit tracker app, pick our colours and fonts
evals.expected_output: Gathers product type, audience and mood words; proposes three directions with token sets for light and dark; fills assets/palette-preview.html; runs the contrast script on every text pair; writes DESIGN.md from the template after the user picks.
